text: Good morning, everyone. Here is the plan for the concert weekend. On Friday we load the van at 9 in the morning and leave Zagreb by 10. The drive to Split takes about four hours, so we should arrive around 2 in the afternoon. The sound check starts at 5, and the doors open at 8. We have 12 songs in the first set and 9 in the second set. Please check your instruments tonight, new strings, spare batteries, and the in-air monitors. The hotel is booked for two nights, and breakfast is from 7 to 10. On Saturday morning, we record a short video for the festival. So wear something simple and bright. Marija will bring the camera and two lights. On Sunday we drive back after lunch. If anything changes, I will send a message to the group. Thank you, and see you on Friday.
